attempts.text:
**The window opens on a single spine column.** Column 0, `selB`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0.4% of calls. The model names 99% of them, at 0.05 bits.

**A fork follows at column 1**, `yiaY`, carried by 90%, in a region of plasticity in 92% of calls.

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 93 against 90%, and hesitates less there, 0.21 against 0.33 bits. Its most hesitant column, 3, a fork column, is at 0.98 bits.

**The window ends in fork and variable columns.** Columns 73 to 79, `yhjB` to `mdtF`, are carried by 59 to 89%, all persistent. The last column is `mdtF`, in 59% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 92% of genes**, 0.26 bits on average, perplexity 1.5 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.42 against 0.18 bits, and names about as many genes, 90% against 93%.

label: selB
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the selB window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor selB, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 120 to 199 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying selB once); 43,196 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.26 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 30,977 calls, named 95%, 0.17 bits; shell 12,133 calls, named 86%, 0.49 bits; cloud 86 calls, named 14%, 1.57 bits. Outside an RGP 29,077 calls, named 93%, 0.18 bits; inside an RGP 14,119 calls, named 90%, 0.42 bits. Columns: 50 spine, 9 fork, 21 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.42 against 0.18 bits) and names about as many genes (90% against 93%); 14,119 of the 43,196 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 3 ("hypothetical protein", a fork column) 0.98 bits, RGP 94%; column 34 ("IS3-like element IS150 family transposa…", a variable column) 0.69 bits, RGP 2%; column 4 (yiaW, a fork column) 0.60 bits, RGP 94%. The 27 columns (columns 1-17 and 54-63) where most calls are in an RGP: named 91%, 0.36 bits on average; the other 53 columns: named 93%, 0.21 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 50 spine columns: named 93%, 0.21 bits on average; the 30 fork and variable columns: named 90%, 0.33 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 3, is a fork column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 2 (spine), RGP 94%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0.4%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0.4%. Genes: selB. named 99%; 0.05 bits.
[S2] 2. column 1 fork: share 90%, all S, RGP 92%. named 91%; 0.41 bits.
[S2.c1]    1: yiaY S 90% "L-threonine dehydrogenase"; also "IS1 family transposase" S 30%
[S3] 3. column 2 spine: share 92%, all P, RGP 94%. Genes: aldB. named 86%; 0.46 bits.
[S4] 4. columns 3-17 (15 columns) fork and variable columns: share 54-89%, 14 S, 1 P, RGP 59-94%. named 80-97% (mean 93%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 3, named 80%, 0.98 bits.
[S4.b8]    a second branch of 3 families through columns 8-10, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 33-35%, all S; the branch's families: "glycoside hydrolase family 127 protein", "MFS transporter", "AraC family transcriptional regulator"
[S4.c3]    3 fork: "hypothetical protein" S 54%; also "type II toxin-antitoxin system HicA fam…" S 11%, "hypothetical protein" S 11%
